headline: Approved $220,000,000 bonds for a new high school; ratified Teamsters Local 251 contract and pay rate ordinance.
summary: Members approved up to $220,000,000 in bonds for a new high school and school facilities, by a 7-1 roll call vote. They also ratified the Teamsters Local 251 contract and passed first reading of a related pay rate ordinance. They confirmed two appointments.
decisions: Approved the records of the September 10, 2026 meetings as prepared by the Clerk.
Approved the consent agenda by unanimous voice vote.
Referred the Firetruck Manufacturer Antitrust Litigation legal services agreement to three committees.
Approved forwarding Mark E. Amesbury's letter on unregistered vehicles to police, zoning, and Public Works for action, by unanimous voice vote.
Approved asking the zoning director to inspect the Narragansett Park Plaza property and cite any violations, by unanimous voice vote.
Approved asking Public Works to add a painted sidewalk on Rice Street at Archer Street, by unanimous voice vote.
Confirmed Nicki Kent to the Public Library Board of Trustees, 8-0 roll call vote.
Confirmed Monika P. Zuluaga to the Pawtucket Redevelopment Agency, 7-1 roll call vote.
Approved issuing up to $220,000,000 in general obligation bonds for a new high school and school facilities, 7-1 roll call vote.
Ratified the Teamsters Local 251 collective bargaining agreement with the Pawtucket Water Supply Board, 8-0 roll call vote.
Passed first reading of an ordinance replacing the Local 251 pay rate schedule, 8-0 roll call vote.
